ElevenAgents surfaces documented: builder (prompt, workflows graph, free-form and structured procedures, knowledge base/RAG, tools: client, webhook, code, MCP, system tools), voice (multi-voice, pronunciation dictionaries, expressive mode, audio environment), channels (widget, web/mobile SDKs, WhatsApp, SMS, Slack, Telegram, Teams, custom channel), telephony (Twilio native, Exotel native, SIP trunk, Vonage, CCaaS: Genesys, Five9, Amazon Connect), operate (versioning with branches/merge proposals, environments, experiments, agent testing and simulation, analytics, Spotlight, real-time monitoring, alerts, triage tickets, OpenTelemetry traces, CLI, hosted MCP), privacy (retention, audio saving, redaction, Zero Retention Mode) and legal pages (HIPAA, TCPA, disclosure).

ElevenAgents Architect is an in-product LLM assistant that investigates conversations, edits an agent on a branch, writes and runs tests, and opens a merge proposal; it cannot review/merge, has no scheduled or background work yet, and acts as the user.

Reception.ai is a separate SMB product on the same docs site: AI receptionist with scheduling (services, staff, locations, booking page), a client list, orders, quote requests, SMS notifications and its own plans; US/Canada numbers, other countries via a regulatory request.

Outbound at scale in the public product is Batch Calling: upload CSV/XLS with a mandatory phone_number column (other columns become dynamic variables; language/first_message/system_prompt/voice_id columns override the agent), send now or at one scheduled time in a timezone, test-call one recipient, monitor per-recipient status. Concurrency defaults to min(50% of workspace, 70% of agent) limits; Zero Retention Mode cannot be used with batch calls.
